description:
Quantify the parasitic power loss caused by support struts on a Vertical Axis Wind Turbine (VAWT). 

Your goal is to:
1. Generate a NACA 0018 airfoil.
2. Design a clean H-Rotor VAWT (3 blades, Radius=2m, Blade Height=4m, Chord=0.25m, Airfoil=NACA 0018).
3. Run a DMS simulation (TSR 1-6, Step 0.5, Wind Speed 12m/s) to find the Baseline Max Cp.
4. Add support struts to the rotor (2 struts per blade, Strut Chord=0.05m, Strut Cd=1.2).
5. Run the DMS simulation again to find the Strutted Max Cp.
6. Save the project to '/home/ga/Documents/projects/vawt_strut_study.wpa'.
7. Create a report at '/home/ga/Documents/projects/strut_loss_report.txt' with the format:
   Baseline Max Cp: [Value]
   Strutted Max Cp: [Value]
   Cp Reduction: [Value]%
